whatIsSection.title: What Is a UAE Residence Visa?
paragraphs: A UAE residence visa is a government document that permits foreign nationals to reside in the UAE for a valid duration between 2 and 10 years.

Unlike a tourist visa, a residence visa lets you legally live, work, own property, access public health, and sponsor dependents in Dubai and any emirate. It is a requirement for anyone wishing to reside long-term in the UAE.
At Setup Zone Dubai, we provide personalized, compliant, and time-efficient residence visa solutions to individuals, investors, families, and business owners.

visaCategoriesSection.title: Types of UAE Residence Visas
visaCategoriesSection.subtitle: Swipe through 7 categories — find the right one for your goals.

items.title: Employment Visa
items.description: Sponsored by a UAE employer. Valid for 2 years (Mainland) or 3 years (Free Zone). Includes Emirates ID, bank account, insurance, and dependent sponsorship.

items.title: Investor Visa
items.description: For those investing in UAE property (AED 750K-2M) or company shares. Provides 2-10 years residency, family sponsorship, and path to permanent residency.

items.title: Freelancer / Remote Worker
items.description: Perfect for freelancers, remote workers, and digital nomads. Options include Free Zone freelance visa, residence permit, or the Virtual Work Program.

items.title: Family Visa
items.description: Lets employment or investor visa holders sponsor their spouse, children, parents, or domestic staff. Requires minimum salary, housing, and insurance.

items.title: UAE Retiree Visa
items.description: Available for expats 55+. Valid for 5 years with renewal. Requires property worth AED 1M, savings of AED 1M, or AED 20K monthly income. Covers dependents.

items.title: Golden Visa
items.description: The UAE's premium residency option for investors, entrepreneurs, scientists, academics, and talents. Offers 100% company ownership, long-term residency, and family sponsorship.

items.title: Green Visa
items.description: For skilled professionals, freelancers, and self-employed individuals. 5-year self-sponsored residency without needing an employer or sponsor.

items.q: How long does a UAE Residence Visa last?
items.a: Duration depends on the type. Employment or family visas are typically 2-3 years. Investor or retirement visas are 5 or 10 years. Golden Visa is 10 years, renewable after that. Green Visa is 5 years.

items.q: Does a UAE residence visa allow me to work in the UAE?
items.a: Yes. A residence visa allows you to legally live and work in the UAE. The type of work depends on your visa category (employment, investor, freelancer, etc.).

items.q: What is the difference between a tourist visa and a residence visa?
items.a: A tourist visa allows short-term visits (typically 30-90 days) with no work rights. A residence visa allows long-term legal stay, work rights, banking, property ownership, family sponsorship, and healthcare access.

items.q: Can I sponsor my family members if I have a residence visa?
items.a: Yes. Employment and investor visa holders can sponsor spouse, children, and in some cases parents and domestic staff. We handle the entire family sponsorship process.

items.q: What are the salary requirements for sponsoring my family?
items.a: Requirements vary. Generally you need a minimum monthly salary (typically AED 4,000-5,000+) plus adequate housing and insurance. We assess your specific case and advise.

items.q: Is medical testing required for a residence visa in the UAE?
items.a: Yes. Medical fitness tests (blood test + chest X-ray) are mandatory for all residence visas. We coordinate the entire medical process for you.

items.q: Can freelancers or digital nomads apply for UAE residency?
items.a: Yes. Options include Free Zone freelance visa, freelance residence permit, the Virtual Work Program, or the Green Visa for self-employed individuals.

items.q: What if I need to cancel or renew my visa?
items.a: We handle all renewals, cancellations, and re-issues end-to-end — ensuring your stay in the UAE remains legal and hassle-free.

items.q: Do I have to be physically in Dubai to apply?
items.a: Most steps can be initiated remotely, but medical tests and Emirates ID biometrics require you to be physically present. We coordinate everything so your visit is quick and efficient.

items.q: How can Setup Zone Dubai help me obtain my UAE residence visa?
items.a: We provide end-to-end visa services — eligibility assessment, documentation, application filing, medicals, Emirates ID, family sponsorship, and ongoing renewals. A dedicated consultant guides you throughout.
